stratum_definitions.A_qcet_strong_agree: QCET strong fit, stage1_qcet_id == chosen_id (sanity floor).
stratum_definitions.B_qcet_strong_rescued: QCET strong fit, no initial-classification fit (final reclassification rescued).
stratum_definitions.D_qcet_disagreement: QCET id changed between initial and final classification (top movers).
stratum_definitions.E_aux_specific: AUX-OverallQuality (composite/holistic labels that do not map to a single criterion).
stratum_definitions.F_aux_other: AUX-Other residual bucket (extraction noise vs missed signal).
stratum_definitions.H_new_qcet_nodes: Final-reclassification items assigned to one of the 6 new QCET leaf nodes.
